title: Colosseum 1.2.0
summary: Organize private collections, discover manga and Manhwa, return to your reading position, and manage Extensions and Downloads.

highlights.title: Your own shelves
highlights.body: Create private local collections across supported media, add notes and arrange titles. Hosted sharing and gifts remain planned for 1.3.0.

highlights.title: More ways to browse
highlights.body: Explore seven additional manga shelves and a dedicated category for existing Manhwa coverage.

highlights.title: Return to your place
highlights.body: Remember series languages and improve exact Continue, chapter progress and Long Strip restoration.

highlights.title: Preview and manage sources
highlights.body: Inspect URL manifests and manage installed source instances with their own configuration and artwork.

highlights.title: Keep Vault in step
highlights.body: Synchronize download-backed shelves and delete downloads in bulk while preserving manually added Vault files.

highlights.title: Optional integrations
highlights.body: Share local media through DLNA. AniList is experimental; live sign-in and synchronization were not release-qualified.

highlights.title: Feria and Vinyl stay unavailable
highlights.body: Both worlds remain shaded and blocked in the Windows and Linux installers. Android and macOS are outside this candidate.
